blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Public schools in Talisay City, Cebu, will shift to earlier class schedules to reduce students’ and teachers’ exposure to extreme heat, while Tabunok Central Elementary School will have a suspension of face-to-face classes for one week due to a clustering of dengue cases among its students. Talisay City Mayor Gerald Anthony “Samsam” Gullas announced the measures on Sunday, November 15, following consultations with the Department of Education (DepEd), school supervisors, and school officials. The adjusted schedules will apply to all public schools in the city, with specific class times depending on each school’s arrangements and capacity. Meanwhile, […]...
